name: mcp-config-scan
description: Audit Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configs for security risks: secrets on disk, over-broad filesystem access, unpinned packages, insecure transport, pipe-to-shell installs — plus opt-in live probing of remote MCP endpoints (anonymous tool listing, reachability, handshake health). Discovers configs from Claude Desktop/Code, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Cline, Roo Code, Continue, Zed, and Codex CLI.

scripts.test: node test/rules.test.js && node test/sarif.test.js && node test/probe.test.js && node test/discovery.test.js && node test/cli.test.js && node test/v06.test.js && node test/v07.test.js
